title: Shared-cache isolation for parallel-safe evaluation ownership
observation: The extracted provider can retain registry-slot handles into a mutable module-global shared cache and sample those slots during constitutive evaluation. Existing qualification is serial and explicitly carries no parallel thread-safety claim.
repair_contract: shared cache may be accessed only during provider bind/acquisition
cache lookup/build is serialized by a named OpenMP critical section when OpenMP is enabled
each provider stores an immutable local table for every unique hydraulic authority used by its nodes
constitutive evaluate performs no shared-cache read or write
same-provider exact-authority rebind keeps bypassing shared-cache work
qbot and default-off paths remain unchanged
gates: provider source audit confirms no sample_slot call in evaluate
nonclaim: This repair removes shared mutable cache state from the solve-time path; it is not by itself a complete MultiSWAP parallel performance qualification.
